issues: The solution incorrectly assumes that every cycle in the functional graph requires an extra operation (a free character) to break.

If a cycle has any incoming edges from outside the cycle (i.e., a tree attached to it), we can merge a cycle node into an outside node that shares the same target, effectively breaking the cycle without needing an extra operation.

Therefore, only "pure" cycles (components where every node is part of the cycle) require an extra operation. The solution overcounts the minimum operations by 1 for every cycle that has attached trees.
